plan.title: Vendor accepts counter offer and QCS reflects acceptance

steps.note: Open the prepared RFQ state with a buyer-sent counter offer.
As the vendor, open the event and accept the pending counter offer.
Return to the buyer's console to inspect the QCS.
Open the RFQ Master QCS where the accepted bid status is displayed.
Verify that the vendor's QCS entry reflects the accepted counter offer.
